answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 10 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 180 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The kernel of the design is public, the whisper of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the timber of honest work is what finally pays.
